profile.name: Fourgate
profile.description: Independently verify contracted MCP writes by reading the system of record after a tool reports success.
profile.target_customer: Owners of agent workflows that perform consequential MCP writes and can evaluate one workflow in staging.
capabilities: Independent read-back with PASS, FAIL and UNKNOWN
exclusions: Remote MCP transport without a verified local stdio path
